vision.name: Sobering Hammer
vision.text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
Search your Life Deck or discard pile for an Ally with a [Continuous] Power and place it into play at 1 stage above 0.
DAMAGE: 4 stages.
HIT: Until the end of your next turn, effects that advance a personality 1 or more levels cannot be used.
vision.review: never officially released: image is overlaid with 'NEVER OFFICIALLY RELEASED' and most text is hidden. Text shown is copied from the card it reprints (S06 #133); visible fragments match, but exact wording on this printing is unconfirmed
